note: The BCIMR's standard charges for private customers (pricing from January 2026): keeping a private customer's account costs 1,000 francs a month (200 under its inclusion offer for incomes below 40,000 francs, a condition the game can't check, so the full fee is written).

sources.title: BCIMR (Banque pour le Commerce et l’Industrie – Mer Rouge), Conditions tarifaires standards, particuliers (pricing from January 2026), linked from https://www.bcimr.dj/
sources.said: CONDITIONS TARIFAIRES STANDARDS ... TARIFICATION À PARTIR DE JANVIER 2026 ... FRAIS DE TENUE DE COMPTE ... PARTICULIERS 1 000 DJF / MOIS ... (REVENUS MENSUELS < 40 000 DJF) : ... LES FRAIS DE TENUE DE COMPTE À 200 DJF / MOIS
